title: Terraform Sentinel Suite — Private network security controls
creator: Marco Chen
description:
Goal: Implement a single, opinionated Terraform module ("sentinel-suite") that encapsulates best-practice private network security controls for Redwood Private/VPC deployments. The module will manage: (1) security groups and recommended stateful patterns, (2) subnet-level NACL templates for explicit deny patterns, (3) private DNS resolution using Route53 Resolver endpoints and conditional forwarding, and (4) egress policy enforcement hooks (proxy daemon + optional AWS Network Firewall rules).

Scope: The initial MVP must be consumable by both hosted Private control plane and on-prem customers (where AWS primitives map 1:1). The module should expose knobs for: allowlist vs denylist egress, per-environment proxy endpoints, split-horizon DNS settings, and strict vs permissive default SGs. We will provide migration helpers to upgrade from the legacy 'vpc-guard' module used by earlier stacks.

Non-goals: Implementing a bespoke packet-inspection appliance, replacing customer-managed firewalls, or adding enterprise-only RBAC (handled in separate RBAC module).
tasks: Design module public API (inputs/outputs) and write README with recommended consumption examples
Implement SG submodule with named templates (app-tier, data-tier, mgmt-tier) and least-privilege rules
Implement NACL submodule with default deny/elevated-logging template and strict ephemeral port ranges
Add private DNS submodule: Route53 Resolver inbound/outbound endpoints + conditional forwarding options
Add egress policy options: proxy integration (env var config) and Network Firewall rules toggle
Create automated upgrade path: state migration guide, terraform import scripts, and example PRs
Add health checks: CloudWatch metrics, Synthetics (basic DNS resolution and outbound e2e), and Terraform postapply validation using null_resource/local-exec
Write Terratest integration suite and CI job (plan/apply/destroy in a sandbox account)
Create console observability outputs: exported CloudWatch log groups and tags for cost and SLO tracking
Open initial RFC and schedule cross-team review with Security and Infra
acceptance_criteria: Module published in internal registry with semantic versioning and CHANGELOG
Module passes Terratest suite in CI against a sandbox account
Upgrade path documented with at least one sample repo migration PR
Private DNS resolution verified across two AZs with Route53 Resolver endpoints
Egress policy enforced in two modes (proxy + network-firewall) and canary rollout documented
Health checks emit metrics and a 'module/healthy' synthetic succeeds in CI
